limitations: Fixture setup deploys and funds local mock contracts before the measured shadow window.
Trusted task catalog and allowlisted loopback provider; no permissionless market or LLM planning.
Controlled delivery responses and Unknown fault; payments, hidden Docker verdicts and settlement are real local observations.
Cash-only policy; borrowing alternatives, native gas valuation and success probabilities are not covered.
The owned local wallet has one writer; preflight does not establish a concurrent production reserve guard.
Recovery creates a new executor from durable intent in the same worker process; OS-process restart recovery is not exercised.
No-comparable-history routes use an explicit fixed cold-start cushion and price cap, not a calibrated risk estimate.
